title: Indexed concatenation of lists
statement: For any two bit lists $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{suffix}$ and any $p\in\mathbb N$, the element at index $|\mathrm{pre}|+p$ of their concatenation, if present, equals the element at index $p$ of $\mathrm{suffix}$, if present.
